# Do we detect actual content generated by AI Overview (AIO/SGE)? 

> **Collection:** Customer Success
> **Last Modified:** 2024-08-01
> **Tags:** AIO, API AIO/SGE, Delia, generate, serp feature detection, serp features, SGE, show more links

---

### IS actual AI Overview (AIO/SGE) content, such as links, citations, screenshots, etc, detected in SEOmonitor?

Yes, we detect AI content-related information.

This **AI content** info can be pulled out through **API along with the links such as the ones under "show more".**
The **presence** of AIO/SGE can be pulled out through **exports**.
